title: Singer and songwriter Nate Amor shared a new single "Ain't Hitting Me Yet"
htmlContent:
Singer and songwriter Nate Amor drop a brand new single called "Ain't Hitting Me Yet". Ths single "Ain't Hitting Me Yet" opens with dreamy guitars and skittering percussion. Nate's powerful vocals steal the show. The way he pulls the line, "But I've got to move on," is all drama. His voice only soars to new heights as the song progresses.

Nate Amor's "Ain't Hitting Me Yet" is a special record that defies the subjectivity of music with a must-hear sound, that all make a believer and fan out of anyone who presses play. Everything is a masterclass and does its part to the fullest to make one socially pleasing sound, as you get wrapped up in the magic of the sound, lyrics, and the vocal performance that brings it home to make it a timeless release for us all.
